title: Sequential Probability Assignment against Smoothed Adversaries with Unknown Base Measure
abstract: arXiv:2611.25514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smoothed online learning has recently been studied as a way to bypass hardness results for the fully adversarial setting, which can be overly pessimistic. In this framework, the adversary is constrained to generate contexts from distributions having a bounded density with respect to some fixed base measure $\mu$. Prior work makes the strong assumption that $\mu$ is known to the learner, with notable exceptions including Block et al. (2024) and Blanchard (2025). In this paper, we study sequential probability assignment (a.k.a., online learning with log loss) with smooth, well-specified data in the more general setting where $\mu$ is \emph{unknown}, without the Lipschitz condition imposed in the work of Block et al. (2024) and Blanchard (2025). translated_title: 针对具有未知基测度的平滑对手的序贯概率赋值
translated_abstract: 平滑在线学习近年来被作为一种绕过完全对抗设定下难度结果的方法而受到研究，因为完全对抗设定可能过于悲观。在该框架中，对手被限制从相对于某个固定基测度 μ 具有有界密度的分布中生成上下文。先前的工作大多强假设学习者已知 μ，显著的例外包括 Block 等（2024）和 Blanchard（2025）。本文在 μ 未知的更一般设定下，研究使用平滑且良好指定数据的序贯概率赋值（即基于对数损失的在线学习），并且无需 Block 等（2024）与 Blanchard（2025）中所施加的 Lipschitz 条件。我们证明了针对自适应型与疏忽型平滑对手的遗憾上界：自适应情形的界由经验 ℓ∞ Hellinger 熵控制，而疏忽型情形的界改进了……
tldr: 本文在基测度 μ 未知且无需 Lipschitz 条件的更一般平滑在线学习设定下，证明了针对自适应型与疏忽型平滑对手的序贯概率赋值遗憾上界，其中自适应界由经验 ℓ∞ Hellinger 熵控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proves regret upper bounds for sequential probability assignment against adaptive and oblivious smoothed adversaries in the more general setting of an unknown base measure, without requiring Lipschitzness, with the adaptive bound governed by empirical ℓ∞ Hellinger entropy.
